mechanisms: The hands' finished event ends the started build of every builder whose site is within 250 of the finished frame and of its type (pianist/mod.rs Event::UnitFinished, `def == done.def && near.dist2d(done.pos) < 250.0`, unchanged at HEAD): two advanced solars finishing beside three others turned those builders' entries to 'finishing an order' (and their progress words were the neighbour's 88-97% before that), their lists stalled, and the player stopped them as stuck at 81-97% (armadvsol_27527, _26769, _10240: 914 metal kept by matching the finished event to the builder's own frame id).

The id race and the stop/remove clash: 'armavp #avp2' on three lists made three plant frames at three places the same tick, and the player's reclaim of the two extras was cancelled a second later by the same turn's queue opening with 'stop', so both decayed instead of returning their metal (armavp_17970, armavp_6420: 208 metal; the race was fixed later in 4ed68d8, the stop-cancels-remove order is a tool semantics question).

A list's help-finish step is a repair task, which the list counts as a filler and overruns with its next step at once (lists.rs `Some(_) => true`; only reclaim steps were exempted later, 5046f71): constructor_19709's 'armmoho spot_73' step lasted one second at 17:57, so the moho the player had dropped at 25% to clear an exit lane, and meant 19709 to finish, decayed (armmoho_28891: 242 metal).
